messages:
maria: Heads-up: opened a docs PR that fixes a few items for Private/VPC installer docs: HSM PKCS#11 examples leaking absolute socket paths in logs, offline bundle checksum step missing, and a link to the old sysadmin guide. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1240

maria: Proposed change list in PR body:
- Replace absolute PKCS#11 path examples with placeholder and show masking in logs
- Add offline bundle sha256 verification step and example command
- Fix link from 'sysadmin guide' -> 'onprem quickstart'

kevin: Thanks — this is great. for the PKCS#11 examples can we show both a PATH placeholder and a runtime env var? e.g. `PKCS11_MODULE_PATH=/opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so` then when printing logs show `echo "PKCS11_MODULE_PATH=***masked***"`

kevin: Also add a short snippet for verifying the HSM socket permissions: `stat -c '%a %U:%G' /var/run/pkcs11.sock` and suggest 660 + root:hsm-user as a secure default.

sasha: On the offline bundle checksum: please use `sha256sum --check` example and demonstrate a staged verify step in the installer: download, verify, then extract. e.g.:
```bash
wget https://downloads.redwood.ai/offline-bundle.tar.gz.sig
wget https://downloads.redwood.ai/offline-bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum --check offline-bundle.sha256 || { echo 'checksum mismatch'; exit 1; }
tar xzf offline-bundle.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood
```

sasha: also call out what to do if signature verification fails in air-gapped/offline environments (manual OOB transfer + compare on an airgapped host).

anil: Security note: when showing example logs in docs CI, strip any PEMs and replace with `-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\n***masked***\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----`. Add a short PR checklist item that docs authors must run `scripts/mask-secrets.sh` before pushing examples.

anil: For HSM examples, include a reminder about not committing PKCS11 pin values to git and show `read -s PIN` pattern in snippets.

maria: Will add the masking script hook and example output. For the installer step ordering: do we want to mention systemd unit changes for the offline agent? specifically, users sometimes need `PrivateNetwork` ordering if they have custom cni init units.

kevin: yes — add the systemd snippet and a minimal unit fragment example: `After=network-online.target` and `Wants=network-online.target` plus `Restart=on-failure`. Keep it minimal in docs, link to full unit examples in the repo.

maria: i'll update PR with all of the above. Can one of you run linkcheck locally against the branch? I fixed one internal link that previously pointed to /admin/sysops (old) -> /docs/onprem/quickstart (new).

kevin: i'll run linkcheck and push a tiny follow-up commit if anything else pops. planning to run `make linkcheck` and `docs-lint` in a container so it mirrors CI.

docs-ci-bot: PR opened by maria/docs: "hsm pkcs11 mask + offline bundle checksum + unit fragment" 6a7 CI: pending (docs-lint, linkcheck, spellcheck) https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1240 :robot_face:

maria: thanks team — i'll wait for kevin's linkcheck and then merge once CI is green. leaving a short note in the PR to remind reviewers to verify that no real socket paths or PEM contents remain in examples. :lock:
